# Brian Hanson

> Personal brand site for Brian Hanson — keynote speaker, advisor, and operator focused on authority, leadership, and applied A.I. for growth-stage businesses.

Brian Hanson helps founders and executives build durable authority and legacy through leadership systems, applied A.I., and marketing strategy. The site hosts the main brand experience, long-form guides, and an ever-growing library of resources on A.I., leadership, and business growth.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, story, expertise, speaking, and how to work with Brian.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on A.I., marketing, leadership, and building businesses that matter.
- [Resources](/resources): Guides, checklists, tool roundups, and strategy playbooks across industries.
- [HTML Sitemap](/sitemap): Human-readable index of every public page on the site.

## Optional

- [Guides](/guides): Long-form pillar guides on leadership and growth topics.
